decode_candidate.approval: researcher approval + new JudgeIdentity frozen before the first J1 call; until then itemjudge-v3 with max_new_tokens=800 remains the only frozen identity and its capacity risk stays open
decode_candidate.budget_rule: per terminal, after the checklist is frozen and the reply exists, before the call: B = ceil(1.25 * W / 256) * 256, W = native tokens of the worst admissible answer (every item quotes the longest reply sentence, every H-/I item fails with two quotes, indented JSON) + 1; capped at CAP

retries.note: no verbatim greedy re-ask after truncation; v3 runner's second full call is replaced by 'record truncated, keep pending'

h1.blinding: reviewers see no J1/J2 output, no condition and no reward; left/right randomised
h1.kept: every human-J1 disagreement is kept with both labels; no relabelling to agree
h1.purpose: calibrate J1 (and later J2) item verdicts and the reward direction against blind human judgement; not a training set
h1.readiness: requires real terminals (G0) and NeedCards (writer) - both unauthorised now -> 0 items exist
h1.size: 2 items per stratum per prefix family, <= 48 items in total, drawn by a pre-registered seed from frozen terminals once they exist; until then the pack is a design only
strata: subject: user vs third party vs external case
support quality difference without any history

isolation: R1 the final evaluator family differs from every training-reward judge (model family and prompt)
R2 final rubric / pairwise protocol / human labels never enter training, checkpoint or hyper-parameter selection
R3 final evaluation prefixes are owner/family held out from every training and tuning prefix (fold rule)
R4 seeds, checkpoints and hyper-parameters are chosen on the training-reward dev split only; final eval runs once
R5 a training reward is labelled engineering_only unless its own qualification report passed
R6 report proxy-vs-independent divergence; proxy up with independent flat/down = reward-hacking flag
R7 pending / refused terminals are never 0 in training or evaluation; trainable sets are identical across arms
R8 every compared arm uses the same reward identity, the same feedback budget and the same prefixes

must_not_contradict.checklist: H- item; contradiction = history_conflict owned by that item (L2)
must_not_contradict.meaning: known refusals, failures, corrections, time or person constraints

relevant_optional.audit: optional_not_mislabeled: an optional item promoted to required is stratum_error
relevant_optional.checklist: no item at all: not mentioning it is never penalised; mentioning it wrongly is caught by the fixed I items
relevant_optional.meaning: related and true, but a good reply may leave it unmentioned

required.audit: required_is_indispensable: reviewer writes the counterfactual failure; none -> stratum_error
required.checklist: H+ item (take into account; explicit mention NOT required - consistent use passes)
required.meaning: without this past fact a reply to the CURRENT explicit need would be wrong, misleading or unresponsive (e.g. answers a question about the past, or would recommend something the fact rules out)

roles.rule: A legal source existing does not make it required; the NeedCard stratum and roles are evaluation-only.
